quest.title: Shadow of the Knight's Blade
quest.description: Vihar and the researcher Safi are currently preparing for a special event that will tell the tale of "The Unknown Battles of the Knight of Flowers"...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x20000, Adventurer's Experience x2, Wanderer's Advice x4

talks.objective: Talk to the two people in trouble

dialogues.speaker: Vihar
dialogues.text: The color and intensity of the lighting are perfectly calibrated, and the special effects are simply spectacular. It wouldn't be an exaggeration to name this "effect-ion perfection."

dialogues.speaker: Vihar
dialogues.text: Amazing, Safi! It's all thanks to you that we were able to see the Knight of Flowers in all his glory, just like in the legends.

dialogues.speaker: Safi
dialogues.text: Oh, pish-posh! I can't take all the credit myself, now can I? Just think of all the work you did. It was far more exhausting than the papers I pushed around.

dialogues.speaker: Safi
dialogues.text: The most important thing now is the candidate we choose to play the Knight of Flowers... The performer must possess extraordinary skill, with an aura that can compare to the legendary Farris himself. Hmm, those requirements do seem to be a bit steep, don't they?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Lighting? Special effects? Are you guys worried about putting on a show?

response.speaker: Safi
response.text: They have appeared! The one and only, the illustrious hero without equal, the supreme candidate to play the Knight of Flowers...

response.speaker: Safi
response.text: No, what I should say is that you yourself fully deserve the title "Knight of Flowers." No asterisks attached!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Yikes, this is one excited scholar! His eyes lit up the second he saw you, {NICKNAME}...

choices.text: Oh my, that's a little much.

response.speaker: Vihar
response.text: #Ahem! It is an honor to see you once more, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} {NICKNAME}. This is a folklorist from Vahumana, Safi.

response.speaker: Vihar
response.text: He's been taking advantage of Sabzeruz Festival fever to plan a film based on various historical documents and folklore, using the latest Fontainian technology.

response.speaker: Safi
response.text: The film focuses on "The Unknown Battles of the Knight of Flowers." It revolves around how the Knight descended into mysterious and profoundly perilous places on the Dendro Archon's behalf, slaying many evils...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Just hold it right there, Paimon can guess where this is going... You don't have any actors who can fight, so you can't shoot the fight scenes?

response.speaker: Safi
response.text: #Strictly speaking, whether acting in regular scenes or fight scenes, there is no performer more suitable than {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Safi
response.text: Should you be willing to perform, this film will surely become the single greatest cinematographic work regarding the Knight of Flowers, and will earn substantial revenue from its theater run...

response.speaker: Vihar
response.text: Naturally, both of you will be adequately compensated.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hehe, with {NICKNAME}'s looks, {M#he}{F#she} deserves to be a star!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Since this Sabzeruz Festival is kind of a vacation for us, we aren't that busy. We should have time to help shoot a few scenes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #What do you think, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: I'm no actor, but I'm the best at kicking butt.

response.speaker: Safi
response.text: That you are willing to join our project is truly amazing! Very well, we shall only film the action scenes!

response.speaker: Safi
response.text: At the same time, we will redesign the Knight of Flowers based on your appearance, and adjust the makeup and costumes of the performers in the other scenes as well.

response.speaker: Vihar
response.text: #Time waits for no one. If you're ready, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} {NICKNAME}, shall we begin immediately?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Alrighty! It's acting time — for {NICKNAME}'s future as a movie star, and for the Knight of Flowers's heroic legend!

choices.text: Fight scenes are really easy. I can give the other scenes a shot, too.

response.speaker: Safi
response.text: That you are willing to join our project is truly amazing! Words cannot express how grateful we are to you!

response.speaker: Safi
response.text: However, the fight scenes are filmed independently from the rest, and we will need to schedule those separately. Once we're ready, I'll have to call you back in again.

choices.text: Mmm, music to my ears. Keep the compliments coming, would you?
Seems like you've got a problem.
